Glittering Memento can be found in Glimmering Treasure Chests, Small Treasure Chests and Treasure Chests on the Broken Isles. This item is also a quest reward from Memories of Ebonchill.

Gloombound Barrow is a small cave found near Olivian Veil in eastern Azsuna. Various demonic adornments line the cave as a part of the ritual required by Daglop to summon Sharazaan to Azeroth.

Glittering Falls is a corrupted waterfall in Val'sharah. It is fed from the waters of Mistvale and extends out into Dreadroot.
The Glittering Gunpowder is found in a bowl near Block Warden Carmine in the Brig in Tol Dagor.
Gloomper is a mistlurker located in Darkheart Thicket. He was taken out by the champions of the class orders.
Globe of Frothing Eddies drops from Mistress Sassz'ine in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Glory of the Uldir Raider is a dungeons & raids achievement earned for achieving most of the achievements Uldir. Upon completion, players receive the Bloodgorged Crawg.

The Gloomy Bluefin is a grouper located in the southwestern reaches of the Abyssal Breach in the Abyssal Depths. It is part of the Riddle of the Hivemind.
Glittergill Glitter is bought from Ol' Fishbreath at Gnaws' Boneyard in Kelp'thar Forest.

Gloomtide Strand is a camp created in western Darkshore after the War of the Thorns. It has Horde architecture. The area is featured in the fighting during the Battle for Darkshore. When the Horde controls Darkshore, it is ran by the Forsaken. They have plague wagons active in the area. An Apothecary is found here. When the Alliance controls Darkshore, Druids of the Branch are regrowing the forest in the area, including over the Horde building itself. The camp is guarded by Sentinels.
__NOTOC__ Gloomtail is a wind serpent located in Gloomtail's Cave in Zuldazar.
Glimmering Treasure Chests are chests located in the zones of the Broken Isles.
The Glinting Shard of Sciallax is a quest reward from Uncovering the Orb of Sciallax.
Gloom Hollow is a settlement located in eastern Nazmir. The camp is inhabited by Tortollan Seekers with Darkspears guarding the perimeter.
Glint-Eyed Frankie is a goblin located on the expedition isles.
__NOTOC__ Glimmershell Hulks are hermit crabs located in Dragon's Teeth Basin in Nazjatar. While they are usually quite peaceful, they will turn hostile on anyone who breaks their eggs.

__NOTOC__ Glimmershell Crabs are hermit crabs located in Dragon's Teeth Basin in Nazjatar. While they are usually quite peaceful, they will turn hostile on anyone who breaks their eggs. Several are found caged in the Grand Menagerie in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.
__NOTOC__ Glimmershell Crawlers are hermit crabs located in Dragon's Teeth Basin in Nazjatar. While they are usually quite peaceful, they will turn hostile on anyone who breaks their eggs.

Glittering Heights is an area of the dream tree of Tirna Eas. Its waterfalls feed into the rest of the groves with water from the Heart of the Forest. It is populated mostly by veilwing, some spriggans, and other animals, but it is being invaded by the Drust.

Glitterspore Lake is a small lake in northeastern Zaralek Cavern home to a great variety of rock snails. The lake is bordered by Slitherdrake Roost to the north, Deepflayer Nest to the east, Shimmering Towers to the southeast, Loamm to the south, and Acidbite Ravine to the west. The rare elite Klakatak spawns at in the center of the lake. Additionally, the lake also calls home to Blistering Shalewings, Crimson Infused Rock Snails, Dirt Shell Snails, Emerald Infused Rock Snails, Mudslick Snails, Primordial Infused Rock Snails, Prismatic Infused Rock Snails, Sharpspine Pinchers, Shimmerfin Lurkers, Stone Infused Rock Snails, and Temporal Infused Rock Snails.

Glimmerogg is the home of the friendly drogbar of Zaralek Cavern in the southwestern corner of the zone. Led by Brogg the Beast, the drogbar are all about lifting and snail racing. The town is bordered by the Warder's Teeth to the southwest and west, Viridian Throne and Dragonscale Camp to the northwest and north, and Cascades Column to the northeast and east.

Gloves of the Helping Hand is a quest reward from Back to the Den.
Glubtok, the Foreman, is an ogre mage and the first boss of the Deadmines instance.
Glyph of Arcane Intellect is a minor glyph for mages. It reduces the mana cost of a mage's Arcane Intellect and Arcane Brilliance spells by 50%.
Glyph of Armors is a major glyph for mages. It increases the secondary defensive effect of mage's armor spells (Frost Armor, Mage Armor, and Molten Armor) by an additional 10%
Glyph of Avenger's Shield was created with Inscription (400).
Glyph of Aspect of the Pack is created with Inscription (295); discovered via Research: Midnight Ink.
Gloves of Potential Energy are a quest reward from Down with Crushcog!.
Glowerglare's Beard is a quest objective of Drungeld Glowerglare (quest).
Gloves of the Plate Fist is a quest reward from The Twilight's Hammer.

Glutton for Fiery Punishment is a quest achievement earned for gaining 10 stacks of Fire Dancing without taking damage in Archmage Xylem's Trial of Fire in Azshara. This can most easily be accomplished by simply following Darwin the blood elf apprentice. He will dance, but you don't have to in order to gain the 'Fire Dancing' buff. There is a quest chain involving the trials, but it is not necessary to do the quests in order to gain the achievement.

Glutton for Fiery Punishment is a quest achievement earned for gaining 20 stacks of Essence of Ice without taking damage in Archmage Xylem's Trial of Frost in Azshara. There is a quest chain involving the trials, but it is not necessary to do the quests in order to gain the achievement.

Glutton for Fiery Punishment is a quest achievement earned for gaining 20 stacks of Weeping Souls without taking damage in Archmage Xylem's Trial of Shadow in Azshara. There is a quest chain involving the trials, but it is not necessary to do the quests in order to gain the achievement.
Gloves of Troggslaying is a quest reward from Mystic Masters.

Glue mines are bladders of sticky adhesive. When thrown or stepped upon, they burst and spread glue over a 10-foot square area. Glue mines are typically sold in units of six, packed in boxes filled with straw to prevent them from exploding prematurely.
Glue rifle is a wide-barreled firearm that uses glue mines as ammunition (and is famously used by some wardens to stick their quarry to walls and trees).
Gloves of Unmitigated Badassery is a quest reward from Lightning Strike Assassination.
Gluttonous Abominations are elite abominations that appear during the fight to save Valithria Dreamwalker in Icecrown Citadel. When they die several Rot Worms burst out from their corpse.

Yor'sahj the Unsleeping calls to the might of Shu'ma, summoning three differently colored globules of his blood. When a Glowing Globule reaches Yor'Sahj, it infuses Yor'sahj with the Glowing Blood of the Shu'ma.
Gloves of Splashing Water are a quest reward from A New Friend.

Glowing Torch is provided for the following quests: *Twilight Scheming (Alliance) *Twilight Scheming (blood elf) *Twilight Scheming (forsaken) *Twilight Scheming (goblin) *Twilight Scheming (tauren) *Twilight Scheming (troll)
Gloves of Unfocused Rage is a quest reward from Hezrul Bloodmark (quest).
The Gloves of Tyranomancy are a possible drop from Oondasta, the world boss devilsaur on the Isle of Giants, north of Kun-Lai Summit.
Glyph of Angels is crafted by Scribes with a skill level of 500; taught by Technique: Glyph of Angels and discovered through Research: Ink of the Sea.

The Glowing Cave Mushroom is found at inside the Waning Crescent on the way to Light's Fall in central . Find it on a small cliff near a waterfall at the southern extent of the cave. It contains 10-20 Starflowers. In the north fork of the cave, keep an eye out for the Dark Emanation, which drops the Abberant's Paw and 10-20x Garrison Resources. Beyond that, there is a Hanging Satchel hanging above the west entrance to the cave. Get to the satchel by running from the east entrance of the cave in Light's Fall and jumping up the cliffs to get back to the area. It contains the Cragsman Gloves, 3x Potion of Slow Fall, and 10-20x Garrison Resources.
The Glowing Hearthstone is provided as an objective for Seeking Guidance.
__NOTOC__ Glowgullet Devourers are goren located in Kuuro's Claim in Talador. They can be found feasting on slain Claim Miners.
